landfall_mark.description: Faint magenta-green ground ring with clear space for the live countdown.
landfall_mark.method: Modulated radial stroke with alternating Bloom colors and an empty central disc.

skyreach_site_ring.description: Pale gold site ring with a brighter cardinal accent at each approach.
skyreach_site_ring.method: Two softened radial strokes plus four cardinal ticks.

sky_sector_edge.method: Horizontal Gaussian stroke with identical columns. Repeat along X and rotate to bearing.

skyreach_way.description: Paired gold edges over the existing road, left to right.
skyreach_way.method: Two parallel Gaussian shoulder strokes offset 0.31 tiles from center. Repeat along X.

skyreach_way_corner.description: Matching gold road edges, left to bottom.
skyreach_way_corner.method: Two concentric quarter arcs at 0.19 and 0.81 tile radius. Boundary profiles match the straight.

seed_fall.source: Built-in ImageGen, three transparent source frames cropped and packed left to right.

frames.prompt: Isolated painted miniature game-effect sprite for Solace. A single subject on a truly transparent background. Surround it on all sides with clear empty alpha. No fog, pale backdrop, floor plate, contact shadow, UI or lettering. Strong silhouettes for a 48px map tile. Use the reference for the Bloom's sickly-green vines and vivid magenta heart, not for its framing or backdrop. A small hooked seed with a green thorny casing and luminous vivid magenta core, pointing down-right. A short, narrow partially transparent tapered magenta streak behind it reaches toward the upper left. Three-quarter game camera.
